name: print-social-dark-purple-and-lime-business-posts-with-arrows
title: Nine plum, lime and lavender business posts with giant arrows and stat cards
whatItIs: A 3x3 grid of square posts in dark plum, lime green and lavender with bold sans headlines, big geometric arrow shapes, a large '85%' stat, black-and-white photos and small pill buttons.
whatItMeans: Modern and confident; lime pops strongly against plum.
techniques: Use large geometric arrows as the main graphic.
Alternate plum, lime and lavender fills.
Convert photos to greyscale to sit in the palette.
Add a stat card among text cards.

vocabulary.definition: A large arrow shape used as a hero element.
Three colours used across a set.
A card featuring one big number.
